stage: private acquisition and manifest freeze; zero inference

dataset.creators: Vassil Panayotov with assistance from Daniel Povey; LibriSpeech paper by Panayotov, Chen, Povey and Khudanpur (2015)

selection.rule: Choose the first duration-eligible utterance of each speaker, then the first12 numeric speaker IDs with an eligible utterance. Selection uses metadata only, before any ASR output.
selection.unexpected_codec_or_missing_reference: abort acquisition freeze; no replacement selected after scoring
selection.outside_duration_rule: exclude using original FLAC sample count, retain exclusion ledger
selection.audio_changes: lossless FLAC to PCM16 WAV container conversion only; preserve all selected samples, no resampling/gain/trimming

candidate.license: Apache-2.0 per pinned Hugging Face model-card metadata

later_evaluation.baseline: existing pinned whisper-base-en with corrected frontend
later_evaluation.normalization: lowercase, remove punctuation, split whitespace; no number expansion
later_evaluation.decoder: existing English-only SOT50257+NO_TIMESTAMPS50362 greedy decoder,224-token bound, current suppression, no prompt/beam/fallback

limits.on_timeout_or_fatal_error: abort profile, retain failure and unrun rows

later_evaluation.candidate_v2_regression: one separate unchanged cold/warm pair on original licensed clean-english-v2-001,WER<=0.10 and warmRTF<=1.0; never cleared by human-set results

public_boundary.public_proposal_only: protocol, selected IDs/references/hashes/licenses/attribution; publication held for root review

scope_limitations: No live microphone/system audio, overlap, broad accents/languages or reference parity verified.
